arms.better: tm init created a project whose role table could not serve coder.fast: tm run reported ‘provider was unavailable’ and ‘provider not registered: devpass’ even though the prescribed environment file had been sourced, then suggested running the same command again. The agent never began, so there was no navigation, plan, or verification. Before dispatch/run, tm should validate the effective role candidates against registered providers and available credentials, explain the specific repair command/configuration, and avoid offering a retry that cannot change the provider setup. Once that is resolved, the scheduler should run in the foreground or clearly explain the no-worker/lease-expiry path rather than leaving the user to infer whether work is progressing.
